backup_storage.description: Name of the default storage pool where backups are stored.

backup_cores.description: Maximum number of concurrent backup jobs allowed. Increase on multi-core systems.

enable_snapshot.description: Whether to use snapshots (e.g., LVM/ZFS) instead of stopping the VM/CT during backup.

enable_resume.description: If true, resume suspended VMs/CTs instead of leaving them paused after backup.

backup_timeout.description: Global timeout (seconds) for each backup job. Increase for large VMs.

exclude_storages.description: List of storage IDs (e.g., 'ceph', 'nfs-backup') to skip during backup. Useful for non-essential caches.

items.description: Name of a storage ID to exclude from backups.

mail_notification.description: Send email notifications on backup success/failure?

mailnotification_only_on_error.description: If true, send emails only on backup failures or errors.

mailto.description: Email address to receive backup notifications.

backup_maxfiles.description: Maximum number of backup snapshots per VM/CT to retain. 0 means no limit.

enable_purge.description: If true, automatically delete old backups when maxfiles is exceeded.

backup_mode.description: Shutdown policy for VMs during backup: 'suspend' (fastest, default), 'shutdown', or 'stop'.

incremental.description: Enable incremental backups (requires storage with snapshot support, e.g., ZFS).

incremental_keep.description: Number of incremental backups to retain (only if incremental=true).

skipcleanup.description: Skip automatic cleanup of old snapshots. Disable unless troubleshooting.

nodes.description: List of cluster node names to which this backup policy applies (for multi-node clusters).

items.description: Name of a Proxmox cluster node.

proxy_url.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for backups to remote/cloud storages (e.g., 'http://proxy.example.com:3128').

verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates for remote storages. Disable only for self-signed certs in trusted environments.

backup_priority.description: Backup job priority (1–100). Higher values get CPU/disk I/O priority during backup.
